overview: ShopEase is a full-stack e-commerce website where customers can browse products, add to cart, and pay with Stripe. Includes customer accounts with order history and an admin panel for product and order management.
features: Storefront with homepage, product catalog, category filtering, and search
Persistent shopping cart with item count in header
Customer accounts with order history via Internet Identity login
Admin panel for product management with image uploads
Order management with status tracking (pending, shipped, delivered)
Responsive design for desktop and mobile
